domain: Positive four-state probability interior plus its exponential-family closure
quantifiers: For the variables and spectral intervals explicitly declared in the accompanying proof note.
assumptions: Conditional rank-seven active-gain boundary construction; no strict gain-source claim
proof_type: exact algebraic and asymptotic support classification
conclusion: The three polynomial inequalities are necessary and sufficient on the positive interior. Their weak zero-probability extension is only an outer relaxation; the actual closure has supports {1}, {1,2}, {1,3} with the stated ratio restrictions.
